, Reason for Mistake: After confirming via Baseball-Reference that the 1916 New York Giants had a 26-game “Longest Winning Streak” and with Wikipedia noting MLB policy that ties do not end a streak, the Planner incorrectly switched to a “wins-only (no ties)” criterion and concluded 22 games (2017 Indians).
